silentZones.explanation: Humacao (pop 58,466) has a damage ratio of 90%, at or above the regional median. Its pre-event baseline was 9.7 local voices/day; allowing for the regional surge (x0.82) we expected 24.0 voices in 72 h and heard 9 (62% below expectation, residual 3.02). Rules fired: A (residual), B (drop), F (fusion with outage evidence). Independent evidence: night lights down 100%; 88% of cell sites reported down. Reported evacuation: 8% of population; after removing evacuees the district is still too quiet. Advisory flag: verify through another channel before acting.
